overall_goal: Perform miscellaneous kitchen tasks including cleaning, checking the recipe, and organizing ingredients

goals.rationale: The person lifts, flips, and reads the recipe pages to ensure all spices are added.
The person clears the spoon, closes the olive oil bottle, and places it on the countertop.

goals.description: Retrieve the lemon from the fridge
goals.rationale: The person opens the fridge and vegetable drawer to get a lemon packet.

goals.description: Remove lemon seeds from the spice mixture
goals.rationale: The person carefully picks out fallen lemon seeds from the mixing bowl and throws them into the food bin.
The person uses soap and water to wash lemon juice off their hands, then dries them with a towel.

goals.description: Return the mushrooms to the fridge
goals.rationale: The person picks up the mushrooms and places them back into the vegetable drawer of the fridge.

goals.description: Distribute the mushrooms evenly on the baking tray
goals.rationale: The person uses a tablespoon and shakes the baking tray to spread out the mushroom slices.

goals.description: Search for kitchen foil in the drawers
goals.rationale: The person opens and closes drawers looking for kitchen foil, eventually putting it back.

goals.description: Check the recipe and adjust the alarm
goals.rationale: The person reads the recipe to find the next step and increases the alarm time.

goals.description: Clean the cutting board and countertop
goals.rationale: The person clears onion skins, tears off kitchen roll, wipes the surfaces, and throws the waste into the bin.
The person places the coriander packet into a basket and stores it in the kitchen cupboard.

goals.description: Prepare the cutting board and onion for chopping
goals.rationale: The person clears onion bits from the knife and board, then places a new onion down to be cut.

goals.description: Transfer the chopped onions into a bowl
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a bowl from the cupboard and scrapes the chopped onions from the cutting board into it.
